commands:
set -eu
aws s3 cp s3://fyp-p82-20261005-018da1d6-803656589923/source/qualification-v2.zip /tmp/qualification-v2.zip --region ap-southeast-2
echo '86c7e9d12e9eeb28dd3a20a956ba57c52eadb8be05242e20d3407befc2252aeb  /tmp/qualification-v2.zip' | sha256sum -c -
mkdir /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v2 /srv/fyp-p82-v2 /srv/fyp-p82-backup-v2
unzip -q /tmp/qualification-v2.zip -d /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v2
chown -R fyp:fyp /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v2 /srv/fyp-p82-v2 /srv/fyp-p82-backup-v2
ln -s /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v2/parallel-v2 /opt/fyp-phase82-parallel-v2
sed 's/@BUCKET@/fyp-p82-20261005-018da1d6-803656589923/g' /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v2/finish-v2.sh >/opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v2/finish-v2-live.sh
# An absolute deadline cannot reset when the diagnostic host boots again.
cat >/etc/systemd/system/fyp-p82-stop.timer <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Original absolute Phase 8.2 spending deadline
[Timer]
OnCalendar=2026-10-05 21:11:53 UTC
Unit=fyp-p82-stop.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
UNIT
cat >/etc/systemd/system/fyp-p82-qualification-v2.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Finite diagnostic collector v2, main blocked
After=docker.service network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=fyp
Group=fyp
SupplementaryGroups=docker
WorkingDirectory=/opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Environment=P8_DOCKER_DATA_PATH=/srv/fyp-p82-v2
Environment=P82_HOST_STOP_AT=2026-10-05T21:11:53+00:00
ExecStart=/opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1/.venv/bin/python /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v2/qualify.py /srv/fyp-p82-v2/native-original /srv/fyp-p82-backup-v2/native-original
KillMode=process
TimeoutStartSec=40min
Restart=no
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
UNIT
cat >/etc/systemd/system/fyp-p82-finish-v2.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Finite calibration v2 export and stop
After=docker.service network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
Environment=P82_HOST_STOP_AT=2026-10-05T21:11:53+00:00
ExecStart=/bin/bash /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v2/finish-v2-live.sh
TimeoutStartSec=80min
KillMode=process
Restart=no
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart fyp-p82-stop.timer
systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager
bash -n /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v2/finish-v2-live.sh
test "$(stat -c %d /var/lib/docker)" = "$(stat -c %d /srv/fyp-p82-v2)"
cd /opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1
runuser -u fyp -- env PYTHONPATH=/opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1/.venv-analysis/lib/python3.12/site-packages:/opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest artifacts/phase-8-linux-setup/v1/test_linux.py tests/test_execution_setup.py artifacts/phase-8-execution-setup/v2/test_storage.py tests/unit/test_phase8_candidate_v4.py /opt/fyp-phase82-qualification-v2/test_window.py -q >/srv/fyp-p82-v2/linux-tests.txt 2>&1
cat /srv/fyp-p82-v2/linux-tests.txt
systemctl start --no-block fyp-p82-qualification-v2.service
systemctl start --no-block fyp-p82-finish-v2.service
systemctl show fyp-p82-qualification-v2.service fyp-p82-finish-v2.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID
